cohort: The study included 33,901 deliveries and miscarriages from women who gave birth in participating facilities in five Latin-American countries.
finding: 8.0% of deliveries and miscarriages had at least one potentially life-threatening condition (PLTC) and 0.6% had a maternal near miss (MNM), with hypertensive disorder being the most frequent condition to evolve into a severe maternal outcome.
